abstract: A 27-year-old Japanese male presented with gross hematuria and right frank pain, and was diagnosed of having a right ureteral stone by IVP. Though the stone was passed spontaneously, gross hematuria continued, and his urinary stream became week. The prostate was moderately enlarged. The prostate biopsy was initially thought to represent prostate rabdomyosarcoma. He underwent a pelvic extenteration followed by chemotherapy with dacarbazing and ADM. Three years after the pelvic exenteration, coin lesions were found on a chest X-ray film. He was diagnosed as embryonal cell carcinoma of the left testis with pulmonary metastasis and received 3 courses of PVB therapy. At this time, the former diagnosis of prostatic rabdomyosarcoma was changed to prostatic rabdomyosarcoma was changed to prostatic seminoma, because placental-ALP staining was positive. This patient had two distinct germinal cell tumors in the prostate and the left testis. He was alive without any tumor recurrence 20 months after PVB chemotherapy. To the best of our knowledge our report represents the first patient of seminoma of the prostate in the world.
abstract_ja: 27歳の日本人男性が肉眼的血尿と右側腹部痛を訴えて受診した。IVPで右尿管結石と診断された。結石は自然排出されたが、肉眼的血尿が持続し、尿線が細くなった。前立腺は中等度に腫大していた。前立腺生検では当初、前立腺の横紋筋肉腫と考えられた。骨盤内臓全摘術を受け、その後ダカルバジンとADMによる化学療法を施行された。骨盤内臓全摘術の3年後、胸部X線写真で円形の結節影が見つかった。左精巣の胎児性癌と肺転移と診断され、PVB療法を3コース受けた。この時点で胎盤型ALP染色が陽性であったことから、前立腺の従来の横紋筋肉腫の診断はセミノーマに変更された。この患者は前立腺と左精巣という2つの異なる胚細胞腫瘍を有していた。PVB化学療法後20か月間、腫瘍の再発なく生存している。我々の知る限り、本報告は前立腺原発セミノーマの世界初の症例である。
